meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: 装上后,当你要求它对比 HEAD 与最新已发布的 npm 版本时,它会直接输出未发布的改动清单:按三个发布层分组,用通俗语言说明每项真实改动,并为各层和整体给出版本号建议。它不会先提问或寒暄,也不会照抄 commit message。
howto.when: 当你提到「unpublished changes」「changelog」「what changed」等说法,或要求查明哪些改动尚未发布时触发。

say.text: 对比 HEAD 和已发布的 npm 版本,列出未发布的改动
say.note: 会立刻按发布层输出改动清单

say.text: 这些未发布的改动各需要什么版本号?
say.note: 给出三个发布层各自的 patch/minor/major

say.text: 这批未发布改动里有破坏性变更吗?
say.note: 按受影响的层标出 breaking changes

howto.what_en: Once installed, it compares HEAD with the latest published npm versions and outputs the unpublished changes: grouped by three release layers, described in plain language, with per-layer and overall version bump suggestions. It asks no questions first and does not copy commit messages.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention “unpublished changes,” “changelog,” “what changed” and similar, or ask which changes have not shipped yet.

say_en.text: Compare HEAD with the published npm versions and list unpublished changes
say_en.note: Outputs the change list by release layer at once

say_en.text: What version bumps do these unpublished changes need?
Are there breaking changes in these unpublished changes?
say_en.note: Flags breaking changes by affected layer
